headline: Nigeria: the financial stakes behind the appointment of Stanley Amuchie as head of Fidelity Bank
summary: Fidelity Bank Plc confirmed Stanley Chiedoziem Amuchie as chief executive, starting 1 January 2027 after approval from the Central Bank of Nigeria. He succeeds Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe, whose term ends 31 December 2026.
why: Fidelity Bank is a Nigerian commercial lender, and leadership transitions at listed banks can influence strategy, lending and investor perception.
original_headline: Nigeria : les enjeux financiers derrière la nomination de Stanley Amuchie à la tête de Fidelity Bank
